title: Sun Park alleged organised operational unit — narrow functional map
definition: For this page only, organised operational unit means Gil Marer / Project Sun Rock's attributed allegation that distinct private actors, the Sun Park Community organ, the insolvency-administration interface and the judicial-supervision layer converged functionally around specified acts, documents, authority claims and outcomes. It does not assert one legal person, one company, a criminal organisation, a conspiracy, shared intent, or automatic responsibility.

publication_boundaries: No node acquires another node's act, knowledge, intent, benefit or liability by association.
The Community organ is not treated as owner of the hotel or as an unlimited authority over private units.
The Insolvency Administrator and Judge remain institutionally and legally distinct from the five private actors.
The functional frame is an attributed analytical hypothesis, not an adjudicated finding of a criminal organisation, conspiracy or common enterprise.
RICPE, Lava Verde, Club SEI, MYND Yaiza and Orion are continuity/context nodes unless a source establishes a narrower transaction-specific role.
The 26 June 2018 suspension and other corrective/adverse records remain visible beside the allegations.
Right of reply, correction and exculpatory evidence remain open.
Professional, banking and media witness/custodian nodes are outside the alleged operational unit unless transaction-specific evidence proves a narrower role.

Do not state that Ref21, Ref22 or Ref24 are fully downloadable from the public GitLab site until route-level verification confirms complete public-safe files; as of 21 September 2026 that condition is not met.
